items.stem: Where does AI add the most value in a logistics lifecycle?

options.text: By physically moving goods instead of vehicles
options.rationale: AI does not move goods; it informs decisions.

options.text: By improving decisions like forecasting, routing and inventory
options.rationale: Correct: these decision points are where AI adds value.

options.text: By eliminating the need for any data
options.rationale: AI depends on data, it does not remove the need for it.

items.explanation: Correct: AI augments decisions such as forecasting and routing; it does not replace the physical chain.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO are good uses of an AI demand forecast? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Setting reorder points with a safety-stock buffer
options.rationale: Correct: the forecast plus its error informs reorder points.

options.text: Treating the forecast as a guaranteed exact number
options.rationale: Forecasts carry error; they are not guarantees.
Correct: capacity planning is a sound use of forecasts.

options.text: Ignoring seasonality because AI handles everything
options.rationale: Seasonality still matters and must be considered.

items.explanation: Correct: setting reorder points and planning capacity both use the forecast with its uncertainty.

items.stem: A routing model returns the shortest-distance route. Why might it not be the best choice?

options.text: Shortest distance can still miss time windows, cost or service targets
options.rationale: Correct: cost and service, not just distance, decide the best route.

options.text: Distance is never relevant to routing
options.rationale: Distance is relevant, just not the only factor.

options.text: Shortest routes always break the law
options.rationale: Shortest routes are not inherently illegal.
AI can compute distances; that is not the issue.

items.explanation: Correct: lowest distance is not always lowest cost or best service once time windows, tolls and fuel are counted.
